mapper.insert: insert into personal_rank(rank_name, user_id, category_id, target_id) VALUES (#{rankName},#{userId},#{categoryId},#{targetId})
insert into comment(rank_id, user_id, parent_id, comment_content,comment_time,id_delete) VALUES (#{rankId},#{userId}, NULL #{parentId} ,#{content},now(),0)
mapper.update:
insert into rank_song(rank_id, song_id, ranking) VALUES
(#{item.rankId},#{item.songId},#{item.ranking})
mapper.select: select work_id,work_name from work where category_id=#{category} and work_status=1
select song_id,song.song_name from song where work_id=#{workId} and song_status=1

select a.rank_id,a.rank_name,a.publish_time,a.total_vote as vote_count,a.total_love as love_count, b.rs_id,b.song_id,b.ranking,b.rank_update_time,c.song_name from (select p.rank_id,p.rank_name,p.publish_time,ifnull(sum(v.vote),0) as total_vote,ifnull(sum(l.love),0) as total_love from personal_rank as p left join vote_record as v on p.rank_id=v.rank_id left join love_record as l on p.rank_id=l.rank_id where p.category_id=#{category} group by p.rank_id,p.rank_name,p.publish_time order by publish_time limit #{pageSize} offset #{offset}) as a left join rank_song as b on a.rank_id=b.rank_id left join song as c on b.song_id = c.song_id order by b.rank_update_time asc

select distinct c.com_id,c.rank_id,c.user_id,c.parent_id,c.comment_content,c.comment_time,u.username,pu.username,ifnull(cl.like_count,0) as like_count, case when cl2.user_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as is_liked from comment as c left join user as u on c.user_id = u.user_id left join personal_rank as p on c.rank_id = p.rank_id left join (select com_id,count(*) as like_count from like_comment group by com_id) as cl on c.com_id=cl.com_id left join like_comment cl2 on cl2.com_id=c.com_id and cl2.user_id=#{userId} left join comment as pc on pc.parent_id=c.com_id left join user as pu on pu.user_id=pc.user_id where c.rank_id=#{rankId} and id_delete=0 order by c.comment_time desc limit 50
